what: How much of the flare shows: a 1 by 1 target written after the scene by a new written material (flare_sight.hlsl) from the 17 samples, moved by at most 0.05 a frame from the last frame's (two targets used in turn), and the flare's models mixed into the frame by it (flare_blend.hlsl: the frame before and after them); not read by the flare's vertex programs
